verses.t: By the night when it covers
verses.pickthall: By the night enshrouding
verses.yusufAli: By the Night as it conceals (the light)
verses.rodwell: BY the NIGHT when she spreads her veil
verses.sale: By the night, when it covereth all things with darkness

verses.t: And [by] the day when it appears
verses.pickthall: And the day resplendent
verses.yusufAli: By the Day as it appears in glory
verses.rodwell: By the Day when it brightly shineth
verses.sale: by the day, when it shineth forth

verses.t: And [by] He who created the male and female
verses.pickthall: And Him Who hath created male and female
verses.yusufAli: By (the mystery of) the creation of male and female
verses.rodwell: By Him who made male and female
verses.sale: by Him who hath created the male, and the female

verses.t: Indeed, your efforts are diverse
verses.pickthall: Lo! your effort is dispersed (toward divers ends)
verses.yusufAli: Verily, (the ends) ye strive for are diverse
verses.rodwell: At different ends truly do ye aim
verses.sale: Verily your endeavour is different

verses.t: As for he who gives and fears Allah
verses.pickthall: As for him who giveth and is dutiful (toward Allah)
verses.yusufAli: So he who gives (in charity) and fears (Allah)
verses.rodwell: But as to him who giveth alms and feareth God
verses.sale: Now whoso is obedient, and feareth God

verses.t: And believes in the best [reward]
verses.pickthall: And believeth in goodness
verses.yusufAli: And (in all sincerity) testifies to the best
verses.rodwell: And yieldeth assent to the Good
verses.sale: and professeth the truth of that faith which is most excellent

verses.t: We will ease him toward ease
verses.pickthall: Surely We will ease his way unto the state of ease
verses.yusufAli: We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Bliss
verses.rodwell: To him will we make easy the path to happiness
verses.sale: unto him will We facilitate the way to happiness

verses.t: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need
verses.pickthall: But as for him who hoardeth and deemeth himself independent
verses.yusufAli: But he who is a greedy miser and thinks himself self-sufficient
verses.rodwell: But as to him who is covetous and bent on riches
verses.sale: But whoso shall be covetous, and shall be wholly taken up with this world

verses.t: And denies the best [reward]
verses.pickthall: And disbelieveth in goodness
verses.yusufAli: And gives the lie to the best
verses.rodwell: And calleth the Good a lie
verses.sale: and shall deny the truth of that which is most excellent

verses.t: We will ease him toward difficulty
verses.pickthall: Surely We will ease his way unto adversity
verses.yusufAli: We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Misery
verses.rodwell: To him will we make easy the path to misery
verses.sale: unto him will We facilitate the way to misery

verses.t: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls
verses.pickthall: His riches will not save him when he perisheth
verses.yusufAli: Nor will his wealth profit him when he falls headlong (into the Pit)
verses.rodwell: And what shall his wealth avail him when he goeth down
verses.sale: and his riches shall not profit him, when he shall fall headlong into hell

verses.t: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance
verses.pickthall: Lo! Ours it is (to give) the guidance
verses.yusufAli: Verily We take upon Ourselves to guide
verses.rodwell: Truly man's guidance is with Us
verses.sale: Verily unto Us appertaineth the direction of mankind

verses.t: And indeed, to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life]
verses.pickthall: And lo! unto Us belong the latter portion and the former
verses.yusufAli: And verily unto Us (belong) the End and the Beginning
verses.rodwell: And Our's, the Future and the Past
verses.sale: And ours is the life to come, and the present life

verses.t: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing
verses.pickthall: Therefor have I warned you of the flaming Fire
verses.yusufAli: Therefore do I warn you of a Fire blazing fiercely
verses.rodwell: I warn you therefore of the flaming fire
verses.sale: Wherefore I threaten you with fire which burneth fiercely

verses.t: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one
verses.pickthall: Which only the most wretched must endure
verses.yusufAli: None shall reach it but those most unfortunate ones
verses.rodwell: None shall be cast to it but the most wretched
verses.sale: which none shall enter to be burned except the most wretched

verses.t: Who had denied and turned away
verses.pickthall: He who denieth and turneth away
verses.yusufAli: Who give the lie to Truth and turn their backs
verses.rodwell: Who hath called the truth a lie and turned his back
verses.sale: who shall have disbelieved, and turned back

verses.t: But the righteous one will avoid it
verses.pickthall: Far removed from it will be the righteous
verses.yusufAli: But those most devoted to Allah shall be removed far from it
verses.rodwell: But the God-fearing shall escape it
verses.sale: But he who strictly bewareth idolatry and rebellion, shall be removed far from the same

verses.t: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself
verses.pickthall: Who giveth his wealth that he may grow (in goodness)
verses.yusufAli: Those who spend their wealth for increase in self-purification
verses.rodwell: Who giveth away his substance that he may become pure
verses.sale: who giveth his substance in alms

verses.t: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded
verses.pickthall: And none hath with him any favour for reward
verses.yusufAli: And have in their minds no favour from anyone for which a reward is expected in return
verses.rodwell: And who offereth not favours to any one for the sake of recompense
verses.sale: and by whom no benefit is bestowed on any, that it may be recompensed

verses.t: But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High
verses.pickthall: Except as seeking (to fulfil) the purpose of his Lord Most High
verses.yusufAli: But only the desire to seek for the Countenance of their Lord Most High
verses.rodwell: But only as seeking the face of his Lord the Most High
verses.sale: but who bestoweth the same for the sake of his Lord, the most High

verses.t: And he is going to be satisfied
verses.pickthall: He verily will be content
verses.yusufAli: And soon will they attain (complete) satisfaction
verses.rodwell: And surely in the end he shall be well content
verses.sale: And hereafter he shall be well satisfied with his reward
